svg.title: Yash Chaudhary
svg.desc: Stylised exam-hall CCTV frame with a DVR timestamp and the camera label reading Yash Chaudhary, Cam 04 Noida. Every seated candidate carries a green pose skeleton; one stands and leans toward a neighbour, a red Suspicious Movement box appears, and a new red mark lands on the session timeline below.
svg.text: red marks = moments flagged by the model this session
